stem.text: An electrical device of fixed resistance $20\,\Omega$ is connected in series with a variable resistor and a battery of electromotive force (e.m.f.) $16\,\text{V}$ and negligible internal resistance.

stem.alt: Series circuit: a battery of 16 V, a device of 20 ohm labelled device, and a variable resistor, connected in a single loop.

stem.text: What is the resistance of the variable resistor when the power dissipated in the electrical device is $4.0\,\text{W}$?
